layout_year_intent: Current Grand Prix layout where the circuit is live; last Formula 1 layout where it is not. The mapped OpenStreetMap loop was selected by published length.

origin.meaning: Local source origin at the point on the loop nearest the venue coordinate, after rotation to the start.

projection: Local tangent plane, x east metres, y north metres. Vertical values are relative to the lowest smoothed sample on the lap.

route.scale_rule: Applied only when the mapped plan was within 1.5% of a published length. Larger gaps keep the mapped length.
route.horizontal_filter: 4 m source sampling; 24 binomial passes away from Harmon, 2 in its authored short reversals, joined with a quintic transition. Dense native samples use local geometric normals.

elevation.dataset_note: Lidar bare earth, 1 m, sampled on the centreline and on a 4 m terrain grid. WGS84 was projected to NAD83 UTM zone 11; that datum shift is about a metre.
elevation.smoothing: 74 circular binomial passes on the 4 m samples (24 m standard deviation). Filters short pre-construction ground breaks in the future paddock; broad surveyed grade is retained. This is an estimated racing profile, not a measured post-construction deck.
elevation.relative_datum: Heights stored after subtracting the lap minimum.

width.method: Explicit 12-15 m venue and corner controls, joined with quintic transitions; estimated from the reference, not inferred from instantaneous curvature.

shoulders.method: Narrow 0.10 m shoulder outside the 0.85 m kerb allowance. Local escapes and the blue Sphere apron are authored separately in escape-areas.json and united with the deck in boundaries.json.

banking: Neutral. No published camber was anchored to a detected corner.

buildings.method: Initial narrow OSM corridor count only. The native scene uses the larger mapped skyline with individual tower, roof and podium reconstructions in landmark-architecture.json and scenery.json.

protection: One closed paved-deck union supplies native walls and visible protection, including open escape-road mouths and tire-protected ends. Pit entry remains a closed game boundary. Escape dimensions are bounded visual estimates, not surveyed barrier positions.
not_claimed: No orthophoto or post-construction engineering registration. Widths are estimates, and the 2022 bare-earth survey predates the racing deck. Cockpit and runtime review are recorded in docs/lasvegas_validation.json. Centimetre storage is not centimetre accuracy.

native_scenery.note: Native scenery replaces the initial generic road ribbon only for Las Vegas. The initial footprint count describes the old narrow corridor, not the current native city.

whole_lap_environment.reference: User Vegas.mp4, night lap 104-124s and 928-962s; registered by corners and landmarks, not playback speed.
whole_lap_environment.coverage: Opening T1-T4, Koval, Sphere, Sands/Wynn Plaza, full Strip, Harmon and paddock.
whole_lap_environment.planting: Original existing Interlagos runtime_leaf_silhouette_color atlas and original procedural palms; placements estimated from the reference and excluded from roads/building footprints. Accepted track assets unchanged.
whole_lap_environment.frontage: Mapped footprints, retained tagged heights, individual low-rise profiles, balconies, rooflines, shop glazing and attached wordmarks. Wynn retail footprint retained using actual road-width clearance rather than a fixed18m midpoint cutoff.
whole_lap_environment.lighting: 512 fixture heads, 24m spacing; Vegas-only material field, diffuse bounce, neutral floodlight and facade fill. Night sky retained.
whole_lap_environment.limits: Reference-based reconstruction, not a measured scan. Temporary venues, vegetation, digital display dimensions, facade details and luminance are estimates. No video pixels or meshes are shipped.
